title: Record the signed deficit of the retained full-target schedule
body:
## Summary
- For pair counts 1 through 24, the retained recipe's idle ranks sum to `7(2K+1)(K-1)`.
- A full target on every port leaves capacity short by one rank per port and replica. At 111 ports and 32 replicas the deficit is `-3552`.
- The rank-seven local profile leaves a deficit equal to the live width. The selected κ is unchanged.
